text: The Fonds für Betriebliche Energiewende supported the retrofit of the Marnauhof district heating substations. The support was given under the Wärmewende Ost programme 2025 to 2028. The views expressed on these pages are those of Falkensteg Gebäudetechnik GmbH alone.
note: Project number WWO-2025-0417. The Forschungsverbund Gebäudetechnik Austria collected the measurement data behind the efficiency figures. The data is published under the project's own reporting obligations.
